name: LongerVideos
description: A benchmark comprising over 160 extremely long-context videos totaling more than 134 hours across lecture, documentary, and entertainment categories, designed to evaluate retrieval-augmented generation frameworks for long video understanding.
reputation: A recent long-video understanding benchmark that is emerging in multimodal evaluation but is not yet broadly established.
notes: Focuses on extremely long videos with a dual-channel architecture integrating graph-based textual knowledge and multi-modal context encoding.
